stages.name: refraction
stages.outcome: One raw paired transfer diagnostic; source proof and exact coverage pass. Missing frosting dominates, no further geometry fit justified in isolation.

stages.name: blurriness
stages.question: Can one common incident PSF explain observed text attenuation without blurring clear exterior?
stages.outcome: Common source PSF improves body/texture but fails five original foreground guards. No adoption; raw experimental state retained.

stages.name: color
stages.proposal: One shared neutral affine least-squares response on original train pixels only; raw incident image, no blur. Gains/offsets tied across RGB and both references.
stages.constraints: 0 <= gain <= 1; 0 <= bias <= 1-gain; no clipping on unit inputs.
stages.stop: First paired strict qualifier, failed invariant, four trials or clock.
stages.outcome: Frozen foreground has backing-dependent response; proposed cached affine compositor invalid. Stopped before fit/trials. No new rays authorized in this stage.

stages.name: outline
stages.question: Do existing source and surface records support a reflected-radiance outline proposal?

initial_hypothesis.surface: Rounded-rectangle harmonic cap, preserving accepted pose/footprint

stop: Failed invariant, required unsupported source, invalid complete path, budget or deadline. No fallback pixel fill.
limits: Historical accepted image includes empirical map and material. Raw physical diagnostics are not same-nuisance fidelity improvements.
administrative_notes: Initial protocol serialization failed before writing a clock or executing any study.
